infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Scenders Ride uses your location to show your position and record your ride.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Scenders Ride keeps route guidance and off-route alerts working while your phone is locked or in your pocket.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scenders Ride uses the camera so you can attach a photo to a waypoint.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Scenders Ride uses your photo library so you can attach existing photos to waypoints.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Scenders Ride can save waypoint photos to your Camera Roll.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Scenders Ride can choose a trusted contact to receive your private live ride link.
